issues.detail: spec_quote only supports precedence, not the train_history/train_taken rollback load.
issues.spec_evidence: When a branch misprediction occurs (train_mispredicted = 1), load the branch history register with the history after the completion of the mispredicted branch. This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken).

issues.detail: Spec does not explicitly define no-update behavior; contract infers hold and marks uncertain.
issues.spec_evidence: predict_history is the value of the branch history register.
issues.alternative: On posedge with no prediction/misprediction, clear history to 0.

issues.detail: Spec wording 'positive edge triggered asynchronous reset' could mean edge-sensitive reset; contract treats areset high as continuous async reset.
issues.spec_evidence: areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero.
issues.alternative: Reset only on a rising edge of areset; holding areset high does not block later posedge history updates.
